senses.gloss: ch. = h.חָמֵץto be sour; to be leavened.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 12:34">Targ. O. Ex. XII, 34</cite>; a. e.; v. <cite ref="H01186"><he>חֲמִיעַ</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 2:7:6">Y. Pes. II, end, 29ᶜ</cite> <he>בגין דיִחְמַע</he> that it might turn sour (vinegar).
Pes. 41ᵃ חַמּוּעֵי מְחַמֵּעַ (not מחמעא; Rashi: אַחְמוּעֵי מַחְמַע Af.) (the flour) causes leavening.—Part. pass. מְחַמַּע, v. infra.

senses.gloss: to turn sour, leaven, ferment. Targ. Y. Ex. l. c.

units: <cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Leviticus 2:11">Targ. Y. II, Lev. II, 11</cite> <he>דמַחְמַע</he> (Var. <he>דמְחַמַּע</he>); v. supra.
